1 Ā. (सेवते, सेबित; caus. सेबयति-ते; desid. सिसेविषते; the स् of सेव् is generally changed to ष् after prepositions ending in इ such as नि, परि, वि) 
__1 To serve, [Page1703-1] wait or attend upon, honour, worship, obey; प्रायो भृत्यास्त्यजन्ति प्रचलितबिभवं स्वामिनं सेवमानाः [[

.]] 
__2 To go after, pursue, follow. 
__3 To use, enjoy; किं सेव्यते सुमनसां मनसापि गन्धः कस्तूरिकाजननशक्तिभृता मृगेण [[R. G.]] 
__4 To enjoy carnally; केतकीं सेबसे हन्त कथं रोलम्ब निस्त्रपः [[

.]] 
__5 To attach or devote oneself to, attend to, cultivate, practise, perform; विद्वद्भिः सेवितः (धर्मः) [[
]]; त्वया मनोनिर्बिषयार्थकामया यदेक एव प्रतिगृह्य सेव्यते [[

.]] 
__6 To resort to, betake oneself to, dwell in, frequent, inhabit; तप्तं वारि विहाय तीरनलिनीं कारण्डवः सेवते [[

]], 154] 
__1 The penis. 
__2 A snake. 
__3 Height, elevation. 
__4 Happiness. 
__5 Wealth, treasure. 
__6 An epithet of Agni. 
__7 Of Soma. 
-वम् 
__1 The penis (also शेवा). 
__2 Happiness. 
__3 Hail! (exclamation addressed to deities). 
-Comp. 
-धिः 
__1 a valuable treasure; जानाम्यहं शेवधिरित्यनित्यम् [[Kaṭh. 2. 10]]; बिद्या ब्राह्मणमेत्याह शेवधिस्तेऽस्मि रक्ष माम् [[
]]; सर्वे कामाः शेबधिर्जीवितं वा स्त्रीणां भर्ता धर्मदाराश्च पुंसाम् [[

.]] 
__2 one of the 9 treasures of Kubera.

[शी-विच् तथा भूतः सन् वलते वल्-अच् [[Tv.]]] 
__1 The green moss-like substance growing on the surface of water. 
__2 A kind of plant.

[सेव्-अ] 
__1 Service, servitude, dependence; attendance; सेवां लाघवकारिणीं कृतधियः स्थाने श्ववृत्तिं बिदुः [[

.]] 
__2 Worship, homage, honouring. 
__3 Addiction or devotion to, fondness for. 
__4 Use, practice, employment, exercise. 
__5 Frequenting, resorting to. 6 Flattery, coaxing or flattering words; अलं सेवया मध्यस्थतां गृहीत्वा भण [[

.]] 
-Comp. 
-आकार a. in the form of servitude; सेवाकारा परिणतिरहो स्त्रीषु कष्टोऽधिकारः [[

.]] 
-काकुः change of voice in service; (this is a variant in [[

.]] 
__2 the obligations of service. 
-विलासिनी a female servant. 
-वृत्तिः a livelihood gained by service. 
-व्यवहारः the practice or law of service.

a. [सेब्-ण्वुल्] 
__1 Serving, worshipping, honouring. 
__2 Practising, following. 
__3 Dependent, servile. 
-कः 
__1 A servant, dependant; सेवया धनमिच्छद्भिः सेवकैः पश्य किं कृतम् । स्वातन्त्र्यं यच्छरीरस्य मूढैस्तदपि हारितम् ॥ [[

.]] 
__2 A votary, worshipper. 
__3 A sewer. 
__4 A sack.

[सिव्-सेव्-ल्युट्] 
__1 The act of serving, service, attendance upon, worship; पात्रीकृतात्मा गुरुसेवनेन [[

.]] 
__2 Following, practising, employing; इन्द्रियाणां प्रसङ्गेन धर्मस्यासेबनेन च । पापान् संयान्ति संसारानविद्वांसो नराधमाः ॥ [[

.]] 
__3 Using, enjoying. 
__4 Enjoying carnally; यत् करोत्येकरात्रेण वृषलीसेवनाद् द्विजः [[

.]] 
__5 Devotion to, fondness for. 
__6 Frequenting, dwelling in. 
__7 Binding, fastening. 
__8 Sewing, stitching. 
__9 A sack.

__1 A needle. 
__2 A seam. 
__3 A suture or seam-like union of parts of the body.

p. p. [सेव्-क्त] 
__1 Served, attended upon, worshipped. 
__2 Followed, practised, pursued. 
__3 Frequented [Page1703-2] by, resorted to, inhabited by, haunted by; वरं वनं व्याघ्रगजादिसोवितम् [[

.]] 
__4 Protected, preserved. 
__5 Enjoyed, used. 
__6 Abounding in. 
-तम् 
__1 An apple. 
__2 The jujube. 
-ता Service, attendance. 
-Comp. 
-मन्मथ a. addicted to love.
m. An attendant, a dependant; न सेव्यः सेविता रहः [[

a. 
__1 Serving, worshipping. 
__2 Following, using. 
__3 Inhabiting, dwelling. 
__4 Having sexual intercourse with. 
__5 Addicted to, fond of. -m. A servant.

a. [सेव्-ण्यत्] 
__1 To be served or waited upon. 
__2 To be used or employed. 
__3 To be enjoyed. 
__4 To be taken care of or guarded. 
__5 To be studied. 6 To be kept or hoarded. 
-व्यः 
__1 A master (opp. सेवक); भयं तावत् सेव्यादभिनिबिशते सेवकजनम् [[

.]] 
__2 The Aśvattha tree. 
__3 A sparrow. 
__4 A kind of intoxicating drink. 
-व्या 
__1 The parasite plant वन्दा. 
__2 A kind of wild rice. 
-व्यम् 
__1 A kind of root. 
__2 Red sandal-wood. 
__3 Sea-salt. 
__4 Water. 
-Comp. 
-सेवकौ m. dual. master and servant.

__1 A maid servant. 
__2 A kind of sweetmeat (Mar. फेणी).
